d: Union Home Minister Amit Shah unveiled a half-length statue of late Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar at the Pune Zilla Parishad premises on November 16, 2026, in the presence of Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis and Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Pawar. Addressing the gathering, Shah described Pawar’s sudden demise in the January 28 Baramati aircraft crash as an irreparable personal and political loss for Maharashtra.
